credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: This work appears to be an abstraction using a piece of bone.  The bone is pierced by several holes.  Two large holes fill the center of the work.  The upper opening is divided into two sections.  The top section has been filled with white chalk, while the bottom section has been shaded with dark charcoal.  The lower large hole has been completely shaded with dark charcoal.
